pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 70 °C·d above 5 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)550 °C·d$(). Best near 25 °C; stops above 37 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -20 °C (-3 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6.5-7.5 (tolerates 6-8.5). Roots 1.5 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 75, P 7, K 55 kg/ha per crop; fixes about 85% of its own nitrogen.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 1 tons/ac (2.5 t/ha).
$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Alfalfa Hay and Alfalfa Seeds. Regrows after cutting.
